serverInfo.name: specsynth-mcp
serverInfo.description: Perandam Space Intelligence: SpecSynth SPS & Scientific Sentry MCP Server

tools.name: specsynth_list_filters
tools.description: List all available cosmological telescope and instrument filter sets (JWST, Roman, Euclid, Rubin, HST).

instrument.description: Optional filter to a specific instrument (e.g. 'jwst_nircam', 'roman_wfi', 'hst_wfc3').

tools.name: specsynth_inspect_galaxy
tools.description: Extract full physical parameters, SFH mass fractions, synthetic photometry, and SED for a galaxy.

base.description: Path to simulation run directory or catalog root.

galaxy_id.description: Unique string galaxy identifier or index.

tools.name: specsynth_calculate_cosmology
tools.description: Calculate exact cosmological distance measures (luminosity, comoving, angular diameter) under FlatLambdaCDM.

h0.description: Hubble constant H0 in km/s/Mpc (default: 67.74, Planck 2015).

tools.name: specsynth_get_3d_galaxy
tools.description: Extract simulation-derived 3D particle distribution, kinematics, and structural parameters for a galaxy.

max_particles.description: Maximum number of particles per component to sample.

tools.name: specsynth_run_sentry_audit
tools.description: Execute 4-tier Scientific Sentry quality audit across synthesized catalogs to verify physical invariants.

base.description: Base directory containing catalogs or run data.

tools.name: specsynth_get_evolution_track
tools.description: Retrieve full multi-epoch progenitor evolutionary track, merger milestones, and stellar mass assembly across cosmic time for a galaxy.

galaxy_id.description: Unique galaxy identifier (e.g. 'TNG-DISC-01', 'TNG-ANOM-01', or subhalo ID).

data_mode.description: Target data mode: 'simulation_derived' (default for simulations) or 'illustrative_demo'.

tools.name: specsynth_remediate_catalog
tools.description: Trigger the autonomous SentryAgent to isolate anomaly root causes, purge corruptions, and produce a pristine clean catalog.

output_csv.description: Output path for the clean catalog CSV.

confirm_destructive.description: Explicit confirmation flag required to execute destructive remediation.

tools.name: specsynth_query_hypotheses
tools.description: Retrieve rare frontier discovery profiles, anomaly hypotheses, and academic literature citations from deep mock catalogs.

tools.name: specsynth_check_bridge_status
tools.description: Verify connectivity to the local SpecSynth HTTP computation bridge (localhost:8000).

host.description: HTTP bridge host URL (restricted to local loopback).

tools.name: specsynth_get_system_info
tools.description: Get current host hardware info, CPU threads, RAM, and GPU/BLAS acceleration capabilities.
